questions.question: Who is Boromir's brother, who captures Frodo and Sam?
questions.note: A captain of Gondor's rangers in Ithilien.

questions.question: Who is the father of Boromir and Faramir?
Where do Faramir's men catch Gollum fishing?
questions.note: Death is the penalty for being there. Frodo lures Gollum in to save his life.

questions.question: To whom does Faramir intend to bring the Ring?
questions.note: He wants to prove himself to Denethor.

questions.question: To what ruined city on the river does Faramir take the hobbits?
questions.note: A film change. In the book Faramir lets them go much sooner.

questions.question: What winged creature does a Ringwraith ride over Osgiliath?
questions.note: Frodo nearly offers the Ring to it. Sam pulls him back.

questions.question: Finish Sam's line: 'There's some good in this world, Mr. Frodo, and it's…'
questions.note: From his speech about the great stories.

questions.question: What does Faramir do once he understands what the Ring is?
choices: He throws it in the river
questions.note: Sam tells him he has shown his quality: the very highest.

questions.question: What jewel did Arwen give Aragorn?
questions.note: Her pendant. She gives up her immortal life for him.

questions.question: At the end of the film, whom does Gollum plan to lead the hobbits to?
